newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Some basis offers weaken a bit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Some basis offers weaken a bit.

text.p: Some soymeal basis offers in rail markets fell Wednesday following a sharp rally in CBOT soymeal futures on Tuesday, U.S. dealers said.
"Everybody is a little lower this morning because of the rally on the board (CBOT) yesterday, said a southeast dealer.
Another dealer in Minnesota said that high prices for soymeal had sharply decreased demand for soymeal for dairy cattle recently.
"The price is so high, they're (dairy farmers) are trying to substitute everything they can," said the dealer. "They're going to put them on grass as soon as they can."
Most dealers said that end-user buying was scarce following the rally in CBOT soymeal futures Tuesday. Soymeal futures climbed nearly half the trading limit on commercial buying.
